import bpy, math, random
from mathutils import Vector

# clear
bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT'
scene.render.resolution_x = 960
scene.render.resolution_y = 720
scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
scene.world.color = (0.05,0.07,0.12)

def mat(name, color, rough=0.7, metallic=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = m.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*color,1)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    return m

M = {}
M['octo'] = mat("Octo", (0.95,0.45,0.35),0.55)
M['octo_light'] = mat("OctoLight",(1.0,0.65,0.45),0.6)
M['octo_dark'] = mat("OctoDark",(0.75,0.25,0.20),0.6)
M['white'] = mat("White",(0.96,0.96,0.94),0.85)
M['cream'] = mat("Cream",(1.0,0.92,0.75),0.8)
M['wood'] = mat("Wood",(0.45,0.28,0.15),0.8)
M['wood_dark'] = mat("WoodDark",(0.28,0.16,0.08),0.85)
M['wood_light'] = mat("WoodLight",(0.65,0.42,0.22),0.75)
M['red'] = mat("Red",(0.85,0.12,0.12),0.6)
M['red_dark'] = mat("RedDark",(0.55,0.05,0.08),0.65)
M['navy'] = mat("Navy",(0.08,0.12,0.35),0.7)
M['teal'] = mat("Teal",(0.0,0.55,0.55),0.6)
M['gold'] = mat("Gold",(1.0,0.75,0.2),0.35,0.3)
M['black'] = mat("Black",(0.05,0.05,0.05),0.5)
M['eye'] = mat("Eye",(0.02,0.02,0.05),0.25)
M['bowl_blue'] = mat("BowlBlue",(0.15,0.35,0.85),0.35)
M['bowl_white'] = mat("BowlWhite",(0.95,0.95,0.98),0.3)
M['noodle'] = mat("Noodle",(1.0,0.85,0.45),0.7)
M['broth'] = mat("Broth",(0.95,0.55,0.15),0.4)
M['green'] = mat("Green",(0.2,0.75,0.25),0.6)
M['pink'] = mat("Pink",(1.0,0.55,0.65),0.6)
M['floor'] = mat("Floor",(0.18,0.18,0.22),0.9)
M['lantern'] = mat("Lantern",(1.0,0.85,0.55),0.5)
M['steam'] = mat("Steam",(0.95,0.95,1.0),0.9)

def assign(obj, material):
    if material: obj.data.materials.append(material)
    return obj

def cube(name, loc, scale, material, bevel=0.0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
    if bevel>0:
        mod=o.modifiers.new("bev","BEVEL"); mod.width=bevel; mod.segments=2
    assign(o,material); return o

def sphere(name, loc, scale, material, seg=32):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(location=loc, segments=seg, ring_count=24)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
    # smooth
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    assign(o,material); return o

def cyl(name, loc, radius, depth, material, vertices=32, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(location=loc, radius=radius, depth=depth, vertices=vertices, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    assign(o,material); return o

def cone(name, loc, r1, r2, depth, material, vertices=32, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(location=loc, radius1=r1, radius2=r2, depth=depth, vertices=vertices, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name
    assign(o,material); return o

def torus(name, loc, major, minor, material, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(location=loc, major_radius=major, minor_radius=minor, major_segments=32, minor_segments=12, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    assign(o,material); return o

def plane(name, loc, size, material, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(location=loc, size=size, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; assign(o,material); return o

cube("Pavement",(0,0,0.02),(3.2,2.2,0.04),M['wood_dark'])

# back counter base
cube("CounterBase",(0,-0.15,0.55),(2.0,0.55,0.55),M['wood'],0.03)
cube("CounterTop",(0,-0.15,1.12),(2.15,0.68,0.06),M['wood_light'],0.02)
cube("CounterFrontPanel",(0,-0.72,0.65),(2.0,0.03,0.38),M['red_dark'],0.01)
# back shelf / cooking area
cube("BackShelf",(0,0.95,0.85),(2.0,0.35,0.05),M['wood'],0.01)
cube("BackPanel",(0,1.25,1.15),(2.2,0.05,1.1),M['wood_dark'],0.01)
# roof
cube("Roof",(0,0,2.35),(2.45,1.55,0.08),M['red_dark'],0.02)
# awning striped front
for i in range(7):
    x = -1.8 + i*0.6
    m = M['red'] if i%2==0 else M['white']
    cube(f"Awning_{i}",(x,-1.55,2.05),(0.3,0.45,0.04),m,0.01).rotation_euler=(math.radians(28),0,0)
# noren curtains (front hanging)
for i, x in enumerate([-1.5,-0.75,0,0.75,1.5]):
    col = M['navy'] if i%2==0 else M['red']
    cube(f"Noren_{i}",(x,-1.18,1.78),(0.34,0.02,0.32),col,0.01)
# side signs - use small cubes as lantern poles etc
# lanterns
for x in [-1.8,-0.9,0,0.9,1.8]:
    cyl(f"LanternStem_{x}",(x,-1.25,2.02),0.015,0.25,M['black'],8)
    s=sphere(f"Lantern_{x}",(x,-1.25,1.82),(0.16,0.16,0.20),M['lantern'],20)
    torus(f"LanternRing_{x}",(x,-1.25,1.98),0.13,0.015,M['red'],(0,0,0))
    torus(f"LanternRingB_{x}",(x,-1.25,1.66),0.13,0.015,M['red'],(0,0,0))

# stools in front
for x in [-1.4,-0.7,0,0.7,1.4]:
    cyl(f"StoolSeat_{x}",(x,-1.65,0.52),0.26,0.08,M['red'],24)
    cyl(f"StoolLeg_{x}",(x,-1.65,0.26),0.05,0.48,M['wood_dark'],12)
    torus(f"StoolRing_{x}",(x,-1.65,0.18),0.18,0.02,M['wood_dark'],(0,0,0))

# ---- OCTOPUS CHEF (behind counter, center) ----
# body mostly hidden behind counter, head high
sphere("OctoBody",(0,0.25,1.05),(0.62,0.55,0.55),M['octo'])
sphere("OctoHead",(0,0.25,1.75),(0.58,0.52,0.62),M['octo'])
sphere("OctoBelly",(0,-0.05,1.45),(0.42,0.28,0.42),M['octo_light'])
# cheeks
sphere("CheekL",(-0.38, -0.22, 1.62),(0.13,0.08,0.10),M['pink'],16)
sphere("CheekR",(0.38, -0.22, 1.62),(0.13,0.08,0.10),M['pink'],16)
# eyes
for sx in [-1,1]:
    sphere(f"EyeWhite_{sx}",(sx*0.22,-0.38,1.88),(0.11,0.07,0.13),M['white'],20)
    sphere(f"EyeBall_{sx}",(sx*0.22,-0.46,1.90),(0.065,0.04,0.075),M['eye'],20)
    sphere(f"EyeHi_{sx}",(sx*0.20,-0.49,1.97),(0.025,0.015,0.025),M['white'],12)
# smile - torus arc approximated with small torus rotated
t=torus("Mouth",(0,-0.42,1.60),0.14,0.025,M['red_dark'],(math.radians(70),0,math.radians(180)))
t.scale=(1,1,0.6)
# brows
for sx in [-1,1]:
    b=cube(f"Brow_{sx}",(sx*0.22,-0.42,2.08),(0.10,0.02,0.025),M['black'],0.01)
    b.rotation_euler=(0,0,sx*math.radians(-12))

# chef hat
cyl("HatBand",(0,0.25,2.32),0.48,0.22,M['white'],32)
sphere("HatTop",(0,0.25,2.55),(0.55,0.55,0.32),M['white'],32)
sphere("HatPuff1",(-0.28,0.25,2.62),(0.28,0.28,0.22),M['white'],20)
sphere("HatPuff2",(0.28,0.25,2.62),(0.28,0.28,0.22),M['white'],20)
sphere("HatPuff3",(0,0.05,2.68),(0.28,0.28,0.24),M['cream'],20)
# neckerchief
torus("Scarf",(0,0.18,1.28),0.38,0.09,M['red'],(math.radians(85),0,0))
cone("ScarfKnot",(0,-0.28,1.22),0.09,0.02,0.18,M['red'],12,(math.radians(180),0,0))

# tentacles: 8 - positions around body
# front two are arms over counter holding things, others curl on counter / sides
tentacle_data = [
    # angle deg, reach, height, curl
    (-70, 0.9, 1.15), (-40, 1.0, 1.18), (-15, 0.85, 1.20), (15, 0.85, 1.20),
    (40, 1.0, 1.18), (70, 0.9, 1.15), (110, 0.7, 1.05), (-110, 0.7, 1.05),
]
for idx,(ang, reach, hz) in enumerate(tentacle_data):
    rad=math.radians(ang)
    # base near body
    bx = math.sin(rad)*0.45
    bz = 1.05
    by = 0.25 + math.cos(rad)*0.3 if abs(ang)>90 else -0.05
    # create chain of spheres forming tentacle outwards and curling up
    pts=[]
    for s in range(5):
        tpar=s/4.0
        x = bx + math.sin(rad)*reach*tpar*0.7
        y = (0.1 - tpar*0.55) if abs(ang)<=70 else (0.35 + tpar*0.25)
        # front tentacles go forward (-y) onto counter
        if abs(ang)<=70:
            y = 0.05 - tpar*0.75
        z = hz - 0.15*tpar + (0.18*math.sin(tpar*math.pi) if s<4 else 0.28)
        if s==4:
            z+=0.12
        pts.append((x,y,z))
    for s,(x,y,z) in enumerate(pts):
        r = 0.16 - s*0.022
        sphere(f"Tent_{idx}_{s}",(x,y,z),(r,r*0.9,r),M['octo'],16)
        # sucker dot underneath for front ones
        if s>1 and abs(ang)<=70:
            sphere(f"Sucker_{idx}_{s}",(x,y-0.02,z-0.09),(0.045,0.045,0.03),M['octo_light'],10)

# ---- RAMEN BOWLS ----
def ramen_bowl(name, loc, bowl_mat):
    x,y,z = loc
    # bowl: cone + torus rim
    cone(f"{name}_Bowl",(x,y,z+0.09),0.28,0.13,0.18,bowl_mat,28,(math.radians(180),0,0))
    cyl(f"{name}_Base",(x,y,z+0.01),0.13,0.03,bowl_mat,24)
    torus(f"{name}_Rim",(x,y,z+0.18),0.27,0.025,M['bowl_white'],(0,0,0))
    cyl(f"{name}_Broth",(x,y,z+0.17),0.25,0.02,M['broth'],24)
    # noodles: 3 tori
    for i in range(3):
        torus(f"{name}_Noodle{i}",(x+(i-1)*0.06,y+(i%2)*0.05-0.02,z+0.20+i*0.015),0.11-i*0.015,0.022,M['noodle'],(math.radians(90+ i*20),0,0))
    # narutomaki
    cyl(f"{name}_Naruto",(x+0.12,y-0.08,z+0.21),0.055,0.02,M['white'],20,(math.radians(90),0,0))
    cyl(f"{name}_NarutoC",(x+0.12,y-0.095,z+0.21),0.025,0.022,M['pink'],12,(math.radians(90),0,0))
    # egg half
    sphere(f"{name}_Egg",(x-0.12,y+0.06,z+0.20),(0.07,0.07,0.035),M['white'],16)
    sphere(f"{name}_Yolk",(x-0.12,y+0.06,z+0.225),(0.035,0.035,0.02),M['gold'],12)

    for i in range(4):

    for i,off in enumerate([(-0.08,0.32),(0.05,0.48),(0.0,0.62)]):
        sphere(f"{name}_Steam{i}",(x+off[0],y,z+off[1]),(0.05+i*0.015,0.05,0.09),M['steam'],12)

ramen_bowl("BowlCenter",(0,-0.62,1.15),M['bowl_blue'])
ramen_bowl("BowlLeft",(-1.15,-0.60,1.15),M['red'])
ramen_bowl("BowlRight",(1.15,-0.60,1.15),M['teal'])

cyl("Pot",( -1.25,0.85,1.02),0.42,0.35,M['black'],28)
cyl("PotBroth",(-1.25,0.85,1.20),0.38,0.03,M['broth'],24)
torus("PotRim",(-1.25,0.85,1.20),0.40,0.02,M['gold'],(0,0,0))
for i,off in enumerate([(-0.1,0.35),(0.08,0.52),(0,0.68)]):
    sphere(f"PotSteam{i}",(-1.25+off[0],0.85,1.20+off[1]),(0.07+i*0.02,0.07,0.11),M['steam'],12)

# chopsticks in center bowl - held by tentacle idea
for dx in [-0.04,0.04]:
    c=cyl(f"Chop_{dx}",(0.18+dx,-0.70,1.55),0.012,0.55,M['wood_dark'],8)
    c.rotation_euler=(math.radians(35),0,math.radians(-18))
# ladle near pot
cyl("LadleHandle",(0.95,0.75,1.35),0.018,0.5,M['wood_dark'],8).rotation_euler=(math.radians(50),0,math.radians(30))
sphere("LadleCup",(1.08,0.55,1.18),(0.09,0.09,0.04),M['gold'],16)

# small details: menu boards on back panel
for i,x in enumerate([-1.2,-0.4,0.4,1.2]):
    cube(f"Menu_{i}",(x,1.18,1.55),(0.28,0.02,0.38),M['cream'],0.01)
    cube(f"MenuLine_{i}",(x,1.16,1.60),(0.18,0.01,0.03),M['red'],0.005)
    cube(f"MenuLine2_{i}",(x,1.16,1.50),(0.18,0.01,0.03),M['black'],0.005)

# hanging sign front center
cube("SignBoard",(0,-1.30,2.22),(0.9,0.04,0.28),M['wood_dark'],0.01)
# crates side
cube("Crate1",(2.05,0.55,0.25),(0.32,0.32,0.25),M['wood'],0.02)
cube("Crate2",(2.05,0.55,0.72),(0.28,0.28,0.20),M['wood_light'],0.02)
sphere("Veg1",(1.95,0.45,0.82),(0.09,0.09,0.09),M['green'],12)
sphere("Veg2",(2.15,0.60,0.84),(0.08,0.08,0.08),M['red'],12)
sphere("Veg3",(2.05,0.70,0.86),(0.07,0.07,0.07),M['gold'],12)

# ---- Lights & Camera ----

bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA', location=(3, -4, 5))
key=bpy.context.active_object; key.name="KeyLight"; key.data.energy=800; key.data.shape='DISK'; key.data.size=3
key.rotation_euler=(math.radians(55),0,math.radians(35))
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='POINT', location=(-2.5,-2,3))
fill=bpy.context.active_object; fill.name="FillLight"; fill.data.energy=120; fill.data.color=(0.7,0.8,1.0)
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='POINT', location=(0,-1.2,2.0))
warm=bpy.context.active_object; warm.name="LanternGlow"; warm.data.energy=60; warm.data.color=(1.0,0.75,0.4)
